domain-information: A customer contacts the pest control company to report a suspected infestation.
A customer schedules a home inspection with the company.
A customer receives a treatment plan after the inspection.
A customer reviews the technician’s report to understand the findings.
A technician performs an inspection for a customer, applying different treatments.
A technician writes an inspection report during the inspection.
A technician applies pesticides based on the type of infestation.
A technician provides the customer a treatment plan.
A technician selects the equipment for an inspection.
A manager receives a report from a customer about an infestation.
A manager assigns technicians to home inspections.
A manager reviews inspection reports submitted by technicians.
A manager updates service records to track completed inspections.
A manager tracks the inventory of pest control equipment.
A manager orders pest control supplies for upcoming jobs.

domain objects.name: Customer
domain objects.description: Person or household requesting pest control services.

domain objects.name: Property
domain objects.description: The location where inspection or treatment takes place.

domain objects.name: Infestation Report
domain objects.description: A report filed by a customer describing signs of pests or infestation.

domain objects.name: Home Inspection
domain objects.description: A scheduled visit where a technician inspects the property and applies treatments.

domain objects.name: Inspection Report
domain objects.description: Detailed findings recorded by the technician during an inspection.

domain objects.name: Treatment
domain objects.description: Pesticide or control method used to address a specific infestation.

domain objects.name: Equipment
domain objects.description: Tools or devices used by technicians during inspections or treatments.

domain objects.name: Treatment Plan
domain objects.description: Document outlining recommended pest control steps provided to the customer.

domain objects.name: Technician
domain objects.description: Field worker performing inspections and applying pest control treatments.

domain objects.name: Manager
domain objects.description: Person overseeing operations, scheduling, and supply management.

domain objects.name: Service Records
domain objects.description: Collection of records tracking completed inspections and reports.

domain objects.name: Inventory
domain objects.description: Current stock of pest control equipment and materials.

domain objects.name: Supply Order
domain objects.description: Request placed by the manager to restock pest control supplies.

domain objects.name: Supplier
domain objects.description: External provider delivering pest control equipment and materials.

domain objects.name: Supply Delivery
domain objects.description: Confirmed shipment of ordered supplies from supplier to the company.

associations.description: Customer reports an infestation to initiate service.
Manager receives and reviews reported infestations.
Manager schedules and assigns technicians to inspections.
Manager manages technician assignments and workload.
Technician creates and provides treatment plans after inspections.
Customer receives the technician’s recommended treatment plan.
Technician uses and tracks equipment from inventory.
Manager updates service records after each inspection.
Manager monitors available inventory for operations.
Manager places supply orders to restock inventory.
Supply order is sent to the supplier for fulfillment.
Supplier sends ordered equipment and materials.
Manager receives and confirms delivery of supplies.
